evidence.diagnostic: The existing data preflight defines the final minute bar as either 15:29 (start-of-final-minute convention) or an explicit 15:30 close. The full-data preflight observed last-eligible-SPOT-bar times: 15:28=9 sessions, 15:29=1150 sessions, 15:30=72 sessions. The original feature builder only selected exactly 15:30, resulting in an empty positional sample batch for most sessions and zero train/validation rows.

source_timestamp_semantics.15:29:00: Start of the final one-minute interval; the row's nifty_close is the interval close available at 15:30 IST.
source_timestamp_semantics.15:30:00: Explicit session-close observation; use as the session close if present.

corrected_rule.selection: For each eligible official session, use the latest available candidate timestamp in the allowlist: prefer 15:30 when both exist; otherwise use 15:29. Do not accept 15:28 or any other timestamp as the session close.
corrected_rule.effective_decision_and_target_timestamp_: Normalize a selected 15:29 source row to its interval-end instant, 15:30, for decision/target endpoint timestamps. A source row timestamped 15:30 remains 15:30.
corrected_rule.missing_close: If neither 15:29 nor 15:30 exists, treat the close as missing; exclude every affected feature history or target pair and count it. Do not forward-fill, interpolate, or substitute a nearest timestamp.
non_changes: No change to the canonical dataset, calendar, labels, return threshold, horizon units, feature order, lookbacks, chronological fold boundaries, purge/embargo, sample-support minima, missingness threshold, baseline, metrics, bootstrap, multiplicity, method universe or selection scope.
The nine sessions whose final available eligible bar is 15:28 remain excluded as missing session closes under the frozen 1% missingness rule.
This amendment is made before empirical model fitting and before predictive results are observed.

synthetic_tests_required: 15:28-only session remains missing and is not forward-filled
positional horizon remains a session-index offset
